LATEST PROJECT · TEAM NO. 05

Synapse
AI hiring platform

One matching engine for both sides of hiring: resume parsing, job-fit scores, explainable gaps, and grounded rewrites for seekers; ranked shortlists and configurable screening for employers.

ReactTypeScriptFastAPIMiniLMPostgreSQL
View source ↗Open live app ↗

Built with Akshay K R and Devika S · Team No. 05

Read the case study +

Overview

Synapse is an AI-powered hiring platform that helps candidates optimise their resumes for specific roles and helps employers evaluate and shortlist applicants more efficiently.

My contribution

I handled the full technical implementation as part of the team, across the frontend, backend, AI integration and application environment.

  • Resume intelligence — parsing structured data from PDF and DOCX resumes.
  • AI optimisation — rewriting suggestions tailored to a job description.
  • Job matching — 40% keyword matching combined with 60% semantic similarity (Sentence-Transformers).
  • Hiring workflow — job postings, automated screening and ranked shortlists.
  • Access control — JWT authentication, role-based access and OAuth login.
  • Admin & communication — an admin dashboard and candidate communication features.

Engineering highlights

  • 61 backend and 163 frontend tests, as reported in the project documentation.
  • Containerised environment with Docker Compose.

Outcome

A working, deployed application with separate candidate and employer workflows. Usage and impact metrics haven’t been collected yet, so I don’t claim any.

AUDIO → TEXT / WHISPER02—04
WHISPER TRANSCRIPTION SRT / VTT

SPEECH · CREATIVE TOOLING

AI Video Subtitle
Generator

Audio and video transcription with OpenAI Whisper, live processing progress, and one-click SRT or VTT export.

TypeScriptReactWhisperFastAPIDocker
View repository ↗
Read the case study +

Overview

A web app that turns video or audio into synchronised subtitles using OpenAI Whisper, with a built-in player to preview and fine-tune them.

What I built

  • Interface — React 18 and TypeScript (Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion) with Generate, Player and History tabs, a glassmorphism look and an animated SVG background.
  • Backend — a FastAPI (Python) service running Whisper transcription and SRT/VTT export, containerised with Docker.
  • Player — live subtitle overlay with delay and font-size controls, plus click-to-seek on any subtitle line.

Outcome

A working end-to-end tool, from upload to an exported subtitle file. I haven’t benchmarked transcription accuracy or time saved, so I don’t claim any.

E Blood Connect

A PHP/MySQL blood-bank management system for donor matching and blood-bank operations.

PHPMySQLHTML5CSS3
View repository ↗
Read the case study +

Overview

A blood-donation management system that connects donors with people who need blood and keeps a blood-bank inventory.

What I built

  • Users — registration and login with 18+ age verification, blood requests, and donations to a request or to the blood bank.
  • Compatibility — an automatic blood-type check when someone responds to a request.
  • Admin panel — approve or reject requests and donations, manage users and inventory; profiles show donation and request history.
  • Stack — PHP and MySQL with a responsive HTML/CSS/JavaScript front end.

Outcome

A working full-stack system with separate user and admin roles. I don’t have usage data to report.
